# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest version of the [`main`](https://github.com/danifernandezs/keep-awake) branch is supported.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report privately via [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/danifernandezs/keep-awake/security/advisories/new). Do not open a public issue for security problems.

Expect a response within a few days. This is a dependency-free static site, so most reports will likely concern hosting or domain configuration.
